project: Weave Self-Iteration Upper-Layer E2E CI Signal
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-090653. The previous active PRD belonged to ralph/self-iteration-20260519-082247 and all stories were passing, so it was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-091157/. No PR CI auto-fix context was present in progress.txt. Kickoff health: latest completed PR CI run 26069425768 was green; latest completed main CI run 26068337937 was green; fresh main CI run 26069761127 was still in progress with Web green and Go running race/coverage. Local health sampled green with go test ./... and npm --prefix web test -- --run. Dogfood DOG-001 through DOG-005 have committed-looking regression coverage, and known fresh-CI risks around cmd/server/embed.go and US-453 streamless binary responses are already covered. This PRD focuses on keeping upper-layer Playwright probes discoverable in CI so OSv2 service and experience regressions cannot hide behind unlisted specs.

userStories.name: Expand CI Playwright discovery beyond US-444
userStories.description: Strengthen the GitHub CI Web job so list-only Playwright discovery parses every checked-in upper-layer E2E probe group, not only web/e2e/us444/.
bdd_acceptance: Given the CI workflow is parsed by a source-level contract test, When the Web job's Playwright discovery step is inspected, Then the command includes the US-444, Phase 6, Phase 7, VTX-099, dogfood, and standalone upper-layer spec paths.

Given a future contributor adds a syntax or import regression in a non-US-444 E2E probe, When GitHub CI runs list-only Playwright discovery, Then the Web job fails before merge instead of silently ignoring the spec.
Given local Playwright list-only discovery is run over the same path set, When the command completes, Then all targeted specs remain discoverable without requiring a live backend.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/ phase6/ phase7/ vtx-099-system-graph-render.spec.ts dogfood-verify.spec.ts dogfood-diagnose.spec.ts dogfood-empty-states.spec.ts us-456-perf-dashboard.spec.ts us-457-timeseries-tab.spec.ts us-458-hotkey-help.spec.ts zzz-login-rate-limit.spec.ts`
`rg -n "Playwright spec discovery" .github/workflows/ci.yml` shows the expanded discovery gate

userStories.name: Source-contract Phase 6 E2E gates against degraded skips
userStories.description: Add source-level contracts for Phase 6 Playwright probes so withProperties, multi-groupBy aggregation, optimistic concurrency, and interface paging stay active and fail reachable-but-unwired OSv2 service behavior.
bdd_acceptance: Given Phase 6 specs are parsed by the contract test, When skip or fixme guards are introduced for reachable service failures, Then the contract test fails.
Given the Phase 6 probes call OSv2 service endpoints, When their source is inspected, Then each probe asserts concrete response shape or rendered data rather than shallow route reachability.
Given Playwright list-only discovery runs for phase6/, When CI parses the specs, Then every Phase 6 scenario remains discoverable.
quality_gates: `rg -n "test\\.skip|test\\.fixme|not yet wired|unavailable" web/e2e/phase6` returns no degraded-service skip wording after implementation

userStories.name: Source-contract Phase 7 security and realtime E2E gates
userStories.description: Add source-level contracts for Phase 7 security, audit, SSE reconnect, and Browser realtime probes so seeded identity, policy, and subscription failures remain hard assertions.
bdd_acceptance: Given Phase 7 specs are parsed by the contract test, When a reachable backend skip or optional-service status allowance is introduced, Then the contract test fails.
Given policy and audit probes run against seeded users, When their source is inspected, Then they assert expected allow/deny semantics for concrete users and object types.
Given realtime probes run in list-only discovery, When CI parses phase7/, Then SSE and Browser Live scenarios remain discoverable.
quality_gates: `rg -n "test\\.skip|test\\.fixme|not yet wired|unavailable|503|404" web/e2e/phase7` allows only intentional backend-down portability wording after implementation
